node.title: Half-distance A=1 core-stratified slope-slack ledger
node.statement: At the half-distance budget B=2^39+1, every live A=1 branch has fixed core s in {0,1,2}. After stripping that core, its degree-d residual apolar generator has exact separation rank e+1 and traces a rational normal curve. Euclidean division of the contracted root budget gives an exact core-dependent cap T_max and remainder eta. Every failure of T<=2^39+1 has slack ell=T_max-T, capacity C=ell*d+eta-Delta+O<=ell*d+eta, at least max(0,N-s-ell*d-eta) saturated residual rows, at least T-Delta completely split clean columns, and a residual evaluation matrix of exact rank e+1 and exact product-code weight. On ell=0, the residual norm has degree at most eta, complementary factors exist on all but eta rows, and component bidegrees occupy chambers of width less than two, with uniqueness for s=1,2. At e=2^37+1 the three cores leave only 3+4+4 slack strata, all with positive saturation. No stratum is excluded.
